source: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (fetched 2026-10-10): the Model pricing table for input/output/cache writes/cache hits, with its footnotes on cache-hit multipliers; the Fast mode pricing table for fast_mode rates
notes: $/MTok (per million tokens). Equivalent API list price at the given as_of date, not a bill (the user is on a subscription). cache_write_5m/cache_write_1h are prompt-caching write rates by TTL; cache_read is the prompt-caching read (cache hit and refresh) rate. Cache reads are 0.1x input except claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 at 0.05x ($0.20 and $0.10) and claude-fable-5-1 at 0.025x ($0.25); claude-fable-5 uses the standard 0.1x. Sonnet 5's $2/$10 is its standard price (the planned rise to $3/$15 on 2026-09-01 was cancelled). Fast mode (usage.speed == "fast") is a Claude API research preview for claude-opus-5-5 ($8/$40), claude-opus-5 and claude-opus-4-8 ($10/$50). The pricing page says prompt-caching multipliers apply on top of fast-mode rates, but session_cost.py prices fast-mode cache tokens at the model's standard cache rates, so a fast-mode turn's cache cost is understated.
